info.title: Google Cloud Storage Universal API
info.description: Call Google Cloud Storage actions through MindCloud's Universal API.

post.description: Composes multiple objects into one in Google Cloud Storage.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

destinationBucket.description: Bucket to create the composed object in.

sourceObjects[].name.description: Name of a source object to compose. All source objects must be in the selected destination bucket.

sourceObjects[].generation.description: Generation of the source object to use.

sourceObjects[].objectPreconditions.description: Conditions that must be met for the source object to be used in composition.

sourceObjects[].objectPreconditions.ifGe.description: Only compose if the source object generation matches this value.

deleteSourceObjects.description: Whether to delete source objects after composition.
